mapper.update: UPDATE source SET openalex_id = #{o.openalexId}, issn_l = #{o.issnL}, issns = #{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, title = #{o.title}, publisher = #{o.publisher}, host = #{o.host}, is_oa = #{o.isOa}, in_doaj = #{o.inDoaj}, tier = #{o.tier}, origin = #{o.origin}, adapter_config = #{o.adapterConfig, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, active = #{o.active}, subfields = #{o.subfields, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, primary_subfield = #{o.primarySubfield}, journal_type = #{o.journalType}, taxgroups = #{o.taxgroups, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, taxgroup_shares = #{o.taxgroupShares, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, codes = #{o.codes, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, oa_model = #{o.oaModel}, country = #{o.country}, name_density = #{o.nameDensity}, act_rate = #{o.actRate}, works_per_year = #{o.worksPerYear}, last_harvested = #{o.lastHarvested}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{o.id}

INSERT INTO source (openalex_id, issn_l, issns, title, publisher, host, country, origin, tier, tier_set_by) VALUES (#{o.openalexId}, #{o.issnL}, COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), COALESCE(#{o.title}, (COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]))[1], #{o.issnL}, #{o.openalexId}), #{o.publisher}, #{o.host}, #{o.country}, COALESCE(#{o.origin}, 'DISCOVERED'), 'CANDIDATE', 'SEED') RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE source s SET issn_l = n.issn_l, issns = n.issns, title = n.title, publisher = n.publisher, country = n.country, openalex_id = n.openalex_id, host = n.host, modified = now() FROM (SELECT id, COALESCE(#{issnL}, issn_l) AS issn_l, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT i FROM unnest(issns || COALESCE(#{issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[])) i WHERE i IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i) AS issns, COALESCE(#{title}, title) AS title, COALESCE(#{publisher}, publisher) AS publisher, COALESCE(#{country}, country) AS country, COALESCE(#{openalexId}, openalex_id) AS openalex_id, COALESCE(#{host}, host) AS host FROM source WHERE id = #{id}) n WHERE s.id = n.id AND (s.issn_l, s.issns, s.title, s.publisher, s.country, s.openalex_id, s.host) IS DISTINCT FROM (n.issn_l, n.issns, n.title, n.publisher, n.country, n.openalex_id, n.host)

UPDATE source SET in_doaj = #{inDoaj}, doaj_discontinued = #{discontinued}, successor_issns = #{successorIssns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND (in_doaj, doaj_discontinued, successor_issns) IS DISTINCT FROM (#{inDoaj}, #{discontinued}::date, #{successorIssns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work WHERE source_id = #{id})

WITH r AS ( UPDATE source_route m SET source_id = #{to} WHERE m.source_id = #{from} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_route t WHERE t.source_id = #{to} AND t.layer = m.layer AND t.config = m.config) RETURNING 1), c AS ( UPDATE source_classification_raw m SET source_id = #{to} WHERE m.source_id = #{from} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_classification_raw t WHERE t.source_id = #{to} AND t.scheme = m.scheme) RETURNING 1), sm AS (UPDATE source_sample SET source_id = #{to} WHERE source_id = #{from} RETURNING 1), rg AS (UPDATE source_registration SET source_id = #{to} WHERE source_id = #{from} RETURNING 1), cv AS ( UPDATE source_layer_coverage m SET source_id = #{to} WHERE m.source_id = #{from} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_layer_coverage t WHERE t.source_id = #{to} AND t.layer = m.layer) RETURNING 1), ws AS (UPDATE work_sighting SET source_id = #{to} WHERE source_id = #{from} RETURNING 1), sb AS ( UPDATE subscription m SET target = CAST(#{to} AS text) WHERE m.type = 'SOURCE' AND m.target = CAST(#{from} AS text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription t WHERE t.user_id = m.user_id AND t.type = 'SOURCE' AND t.target = CAST(#{to} AS text)) RETURNING 1), sd AS ( DELETE FROM subscription m WHERE m.type = 'SOURCE' AND m.target = CAST(#{from} AS text) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription t WHERE t.user_id = m.user_id AND t.type = 'SOURCE' AND t.target = CAST(#{to} AS text)) RETURNING 1), cb AS (UPDATE source SET continued_by = CASE WHEN id = #{to} THEN NULL ELSE #{to} END WHERE continued_by = #{from} RETURNING 1) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c) + (SELECT count(*) FROM sm) + (SELECT count(*) FROM rg) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cv) + (SELECT count(*) FROM ws) + (SELECT count(*) FROM sb) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cb)

mapper.select: INSERT INTO source (openalex_id, issn_l, issns, title, publisher, host, is_oa, in_doaj, tier, origin, adapter_config, active, subfields, primary_subfield, journal_type, taxgroups, taxgroup_shares, codes, oa_model, country, name_density, act_rate, works_per_year, last_harvested, tier_set_by) VALUES (#{o.openalexId}, #{o.issnL}, COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.title}, #{o.publisher}, #{o.host}, #{o.isOa}, #{o.inDoaj}, COALESCE(#{o.tier}, 'CANDIDATE'), #{o.origin}, COALESCE(#{o.adapterConfig, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{o.active}, true), COALESCE(#{o.subfields, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.primarySubfield}, #{o.journalType}, COALESCE(#{o.taxgroups, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), COALESCE(#{o.taxgroupShares, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{o.codes, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.oaModel}, #{o.country}, #{o.nameDensity}, #{o.actRate}, #{o.worksPerYear}, #{o.lastHarvested}, COALESCE(#{o.tierSetBy}, 'SEED')) ON CONFLICT (openalex_id) DO UPDATE SET issn_l = EXCLUDED.issn_l, issns = EXCLUDED.issns, title = EXCLUDED.title, publisher = EXCLUDED.publisher, host = EXCLUDED.host, is_oa = EXCLUDED.is_oa, in_doaj = EXCLUDED.in_doaj, oa_model = EXCLUDED.oa_model, country = EXCLUDED.country, works_per_year = EXCLUDED.works_per_year, modified = now() RETURNING id
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.tier = 'BROAD' AND s.act_rate >= #{p.promoteActRate} AND s.name_density >= #{p.promoteNames} THEN 'PROMOTE' WHEN s.tier = 'CORE' AND s.act_rate < #{p.demoteCoreActRate} AND s.name_density < #{p.demoteCoreNames} THEN 'DEMOTE' WHEN s.tier = 'BROAD' AND s.name_density < #{p.demoteBroadNames} THEN 'DEMOTE' END

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_signal g WHERE g.source_id = s.id AND ( (s.publication_status = 'CEASED' AND g.origin = 'BLR' AND jsonb_typeof(g.detail -> 'lastSeen') = 'string' AND (g.detail ->> 'lastSeen') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8]))' AND substring(g.detail ->> 'lastSeen' from 1 for 10)::date > coalesce(s.status_changed, s.created)::date) OR (s.publication_status = 'CEASED' AND g.origin = 'REGISTERED' AND g.first_seen > coalesce(s.status_changed, s.created)) OR (s.publication_status <> 'CEASED' AND s.tier = 'EXCLUDED' AND g.origin = 'REGISTERED' AND g.first_seen > now() - interval '90 days')))
(s.origin = 'REGISTERED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_registration r WHERE r.source_id = s.id AND r.state <> 'WITHDRAWN'))
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM source s

SELECT s.id, AS proposal, (s.dormant_since IS NOT NULL) AS dormant, AS revival, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM source_registration r WHERE r.source_id = s.id AND r.state <> 'WITHDRAWN') AS registrations, (SELECT string_agg(o, ',' ORDER BY o) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT origin AS o FROM source_signal WHERE source_id = s.id) x) AS signal_origins, (SELECT string_agg(st || ':' || n, ',' ORDER BY st) FROM (SELECT status AS st, count(*) AS n FROM source_route WHERE source_id = s.id GROUP BY status) y) AS routes FROM source s WHERE s.id IN #{i}
mapper.update: UPDATE source SET subfields = #{codes, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, primary_subfield = (#{codes, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}::text[])[1], discipline_source = 'ADMIN', discipline_set_by = 'ADMIN', modified = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source SET discipline_set_by = 'DERIVED', modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND discipline_set_by = 'ADMIN'
mapper.select: SELECT tier, count(*) AS n FROM source GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier

SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.tier, count(*) AS works, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.has_acts) AS acts, COALESCE(sum(n.names), 0) AS names FROM source s JOIN work w ON w.source_id = s.id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year >= #{fromYear} LEFT JOIN (SELECT work_id, count(*) AS names FROM work_name WHERE NOT only_reference GROUP BY work_id) n ON n.work_id = w.id GROUP BY s.id, s.tier HAVING count(*) >= #{minWorks}

SELECT w.source_id AS source_id, wn.codewn.taxgroup AS grp, count(*) AS n FROM work w JOIN work_name wn ON wn.work_id = w.id AND wn.main_subject AND NOT wn.only_reference WHERE w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year >= #{fromYear} AND w.source_id IS NOT NULL AND wn.codewn.taxgroup IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.source_id, grp
mapper.update: UPDATE source SET name_density = #{nameDensity}, act_rate = #{actRate}, taxgroups = #{taxgroups}::text[], taxgroup_shares = #{taxgroupSharesJson, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, codes = #{codes}::text[], journal_type = #{journalType}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE source SET subfields = #{subfields, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, primary_subfield = #{primary}, discipline_source = #{source}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND discipline_set_by = 'DERIVED' AND (subfields IS DISTINCT FROM #{subfields, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler} OR primary_subfield IS DISTINCT FROM #{primary} OR discipline_source IS DISTINCT FROM #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM source WHERE discipline_set_by = 'DERIVED' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE source SET publication_status = #{status}, ceased_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CEASED' THEN #{reason}::text END, last_issue_year = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CEASED' THEN #{lastIssueYear}::smallint END, continued_by = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CEASED' THEN #{continuedBy}::bigint END, dormant_since = NULL, dormant_evidence = NULL, status_set_by = CASE WHEN publication_status <> #{status} THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE status_set_by END, status_changed = CASE WHEN publication_status <> #{status} THEN now() ELSE status_changed END, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM source WHERE publication_status = 'CEASED' AND id IN #{i}

SELECT s.id, l.last_pub, l.recent, s.dormant_since, s.dormant_dismissed_at, s.doaj_discontinued, s.successor_issns FROM source s CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.last_pub, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.d >= x.last_pub - 1095))::int AS recent FROM ( SELECT y.d, max(y.d) OVER () AS last_pub FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(w.publication_date, make_date(w.year::int, 12, 31)) AS d FROM work w WHERE w.source_id = s.id AND (w.publication_date IS NOT NULL OR w.year BETWEEN 1000 AND 2100) ) y ) x GROUP BY x.last_pub ) l WHERE s.active AND s.tier IN ('CORE','BROAD') AND s.publication_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE source SET dormant_since = NULL, dormant_evidence = NULL, dormant_dismissed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source SET dormant_since = NULL, dormant_evidence = NULL WHERE dormant_since IS NOT NULL AND NOT (active AND tier IN ('CORE','BROAD') AND publication_status = 'ACTIVE')
